text:
Good Local SEO works like compound interest.

The first few months are mostly work. Profile set up properly. Pages that answer real questions. Photos of real jobs.

Then it builds, week after week.

Anyone promising you the top spot by next Friday is selling something Google doesn't sell.

Can SEO help your business?

If people type what you do plus a suburb into Google, yes. "plumber Parramatta". "physio Norwood". "accountant Geelong".

They're already searching, and ready to call someone.

If you need calls by Friday, start with Google Ads and build SEO underneath.

Google changes how it ranks businesses all the time. A few big core updates a year, smaller tweaks in between.

You could keep up with it yourself.

You could also do your own tax return.

Most owners I know would rather be on the tools. Leave the Google watching to someone who does it every day.
